title: Astro Islands Architecture Plan
description: A structured plan for an Astro site's static-vs-island split, so astro-islands-architect's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/astro_islands_audit.mjs.

siteKind.description: What kind of site this is. spa/dashboard are anti-fits for Astro islands.

islands.description: Every component that ships JS (has a client:* directive). Empty for a fully static site.

directive.description: The client:* directive assigned to this island.

aboveTheFold.description: True if the island renders above the fold on its page. Required to justify client:load.

needsBrowserApisAtMount.description: True if the component genuinely cannot render server-side (browser APIs at mount). Required to justify client:only.

hasSizedFallback.description: True if a client:only island has a placeholder approximating its final size (CLS defense).

contentCollectionsTyped.description: True if every content collection has a defineCollection + zod schema so frontmatter mistakes fail the build.

dataFetchLocation.description: Where data fetching happens: Astro frontmatter (build/SSR), client components, or a mix.

imagesUnderSrcAssets.description: True if content images live under src/assets/ and use <Image>; public/ only for OG images and favicons.

jsBudgetCIEnforced.description: True if a per-page first-load JS budget is enforced in CI.

outputMode.description: Astro output mode; hybrid keeps the site static with per-route prerender = false opt-outs.
